notes.title: Patch 1.1: QoL and UI Overhaul
notes.content:
[p]Sup Gnomes,[/p][p]
First of all we wanted to shout out to the wiki crew over here on the community Discord server - if you haven't already [url="https://discord.gg/Bw9m5Nuna2"]Come and Join the Gnomes Discord Server[/url] [/p][p]The wiki is now fleshed out and well organized. Thank you for your contributions and thank you to those who contacted us with issues and patiently tested debug builds for us - without you it would have been much harder / impossible to track these down. Check out all their hard work here: [url="https://gnomes.wiki.gg/wiki/Gnomes_Wiki"]https://gnomes.wiki.gg/wiki/Gnomes_Wiki[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We also wanted to thank all the Gnomies for your ongoing support, this week we hit a really exciting milestone of 25000 Gnomies! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45134742/188bac705c06a03ae61db86c291001e3674a4739.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]If you haven't already, please leave us a review, it really helps us out a lot![/i][/p][p][/p][h2]What's going on in this update?[/h2][p]We've been busy addressing feedback and building the infrastructure to allow us to expand the game. Primarily we have focused on solving some rare video issues that some players have been suffering from. We've also put in place a new UI system that will finally allow us to localize the game into different languages. (Our next major update will feature a bunch of new languages.) We've also made a bunch of QoL changes like "click and drag box pickup of multiple entities" as well as massive improvements to the UI of the different menus.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45134742/6f6f3c939142b389bc94f413b06321befca38ced.gif"][/img][/p][h2]Changelist[/h2][h3][b]New Relics[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Coal[/p][/*][*][p]Sapphire[/p][/*][*][p]Jackhammer (Replacing pickaxe and hatchet)[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Balance[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Ice Wand and Dirtmancers Wand are both now 1g to use[/p][/*][*][p]Mead now -100% xp but its cheaper in the shop[/p][/*][*][p]Gold top now -100% xp[/p][/*][*][p]Recycling bin is now more expensive[/p][/*][*][p]Sawmill now costs 8g to build[/p][/*][*][p]Flannel shirt is buffed[/p][/*][*][p]Morel now gives +1 damage per mushroom[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Technical/UI/QoL[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added box select to pick up multiple gnomes / moveables at once. Hope you like this one.[/p][/*][*][p]Cheats mode added (click the left eye of the Gnome in the main menu 5 times to activate or deactivate)[/p][/*][*][p]Redid all text/typesetting,[/p][/*][*][p]Redid text menus,[/p][/*][*][p]Redid Map/Guild/Daily Run screens + Daily run new features,[/p][/*][*][p]Global/Friends view,[/p][/*][*][p]Leaderboard pages,[/p][/*][*][p]Performance improvements for endless - There's still more to be done but let us know if its any better[/p][/*][*][p]Backend changed to SDL3 - this should fix the flickering issue which several people have reported,[/p][/*][*][p]Loading system has been improved - the game should now launch faster and with no white screen,[/p][/*][*][p]Redid timestep / game tick system - should be a bit smoother, can simulate faster than framerate now[/p][/*][*][p]Changed some default hotkeys - speed up and down is on Q and E, end turn is now Enter so people don't get rekt for pressing accidentally space - if you liked the old hotkeys feel free to change it back and let us know your preferences[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you have any issues with the update or feel just like hanging out with us and the Gnomies - come and join us on the [url="https://discord.gg/Bw9m5Nuna2"]Gnomes Discord Server[/url] where you can chat with us directly![/p][p][/p][p]Cheers, [/p][p][i]Tommy and Patrick[/i] [/p][p][b]DYSTOPIAN[/b][/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.04F: Hotfix
notes.content:
Sup Gnomies,

We've done a lot of patches in the last week, trying to be reactive to all the feedback we've had about video and compatibility issues. We've had close to 20,000 different people on different machines playing Gnomes since launch and we underestimated how the quirks of our custom engine would behave with all of your different systems. Thanks sticking with us and for those of you who took the time to help us troubleshoot the issues!

[b]Here's what's new:[/b]
[list]
[*] VSync is now disabled by default (it can be a factor in some driver issues e.g. the flickering)
[*] Settings is now stored in settings.json which is human editable if you need to change settings without opening the game [i](If settings.json isn't there, launch the game and it will be generated)[/i]
[/list]
[b]This update will cause settings to [b]reset to default[/b], but will hopefully be the last time we need to worry about it![/b]

If you have any more issues or feel like hanging out with us and the Gnomies - come and join us on the [url=https://discord.gg/Bw9m5Nuna2]Gnomes Discord Server[/url] 

Cheers,
[i]Tommy and Patrick[/i]
[b]DYSTOPIAN[/b]

notes.title: OVERWHELMINGLY POSITIVE - 98%
notes.content:
Hey Gnomies,

We just hit [b]Overwhelmingly Positive [/b]on Steam with a 98% rating — and we couldn’t have done it without you.

Thank you to everyone who took the time to leave a review, share feedback, report issues, or simply spread the word. Every bit of support has made a difference, and we’re so grateful for the community that’s formed around the game.

Reaching Overwhelmingly Positive has always a dream of ours but it's something we didn't even consider possible with a little game, made from scratch on a $0 budget.

You have our most sincere gratitude <3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45134742/4bc95a94a7ebe336b4e761f897272e7f26b77870.png[/img]

We wanted to take the opportunity to do some shout outs!

[b]BoneHairReptile, Rübezahl and Craig[/b] for helping out all the new Gnomies and keeping the Discord server safe as well as everyone else who keeps the community pumping and brings the good vibes!

[h1][/h1]

[previewyoutube=V_Tc5l-S8mc;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h1][/h1]

Our British Gnomie, [b]GothicLordUK[/b] who is now up to part #15 of his Gnomes series,

[h1][/h1]

[previewyoutube=dflEXU3-hlw;leftthumb][/previewyoutube] 

[h1][/h1]

Talented creator [b]trmplays2[/b] who has started a new Gnomes series teaching new players

We also want to thank all of the other amazing creators who have taken the time to make YouTube videos, stream or review Gnomes. It's really made all of the difference for us: [b]Olexa, Splattercat, Vinesauce, Wanderbot, Esty8Nine, Haelian, ambiguousamphibian, Dopey, nocaps, Voyix [/b]and so many others!

Lastly our amazing community of Gnomies over on Discord and our newly founded subreddit, thanks for keeping our morale up and giving us the motivation to keep improving the game. We promise we've still more in the tank for you.

[list]
[*] https://discord.gg/Bw9m5Nuna2
[*] https://www.reddit.com/r/gnomesthegame/
[/list]

On a more serious note! We still haven't "fixed bad", we're currently working on a major back end update that should solve a bunch of the technical issues and improve compatibility in across different systems. We've also made some further QoL improvements and plan to sneak in a few extra relics for you. We're hoping to get this live in the next couple of days stay tuned, we've still in playtesting for this one.

We have also began to lay the foundations that will allow us to translate the game into different languages. Despite currently being available in English, we've collect a bunch of Gnomies from Germany, Poland, South Korea, China, Japan and all over the world. We can't wait to make the game more accessible for our Gnomies all over the world.

Thanks again and stay tuned!
Tommy and Patrick
[b]DYSTOPIAN[/b]

notes.title: Patch 1.03: Hot Fix
notes.content:
[h2]Patch 1.03[/h2]

Sup Gnomies,

Just a quick hotfix update with what we've been working on over the last few days. Thanks every one for being so patient with us. We're beaten and burned but the amazing support has helped give us the mana regen buff we've needed to keep going!

[list]
[b]Some Endless Mode Performance Improvements
[/b][*] Removed unnecessary logging
[*] Capped max number of enemies in endless mode (minimal difference to the outcome of the round but drastically improves performance)

[b]Achievements Fix
[/b][*] Changed how achievements are logged. Hopefully solves the problems people are having (thank you for you patience with this)
[*] Achievements are now awarded at the end of each day

[b]Improved UI/UX:
[/b][*] Sewer Pipe now changes appearance of swamp tiles
[*] Diamond Tier Trophy added for our endless loving Gnomies 
[/list]

If you haven't already, please leave us a review, it really helps with the visibility of Gnomes. We're trying our best to reach Overwhelmingly Positive which requires 500 reviews at 95% positive. So far we are very much on track with over 300 reviews at 98% positive!

Thanks everyone for you support, please keep sending us bug reports and feedback, we're going to continue making improvements. Even if we don't have the time to respond, we read everything and are focused on improving the game in every area we can.

In the near future, we'll announce a roadmap with our future plans for Gnomes. This will include some of the big features everyone has been begging for as well as some new content.

Stay Tuned,
Tommy and Patrick
DYSTOPIAN

notes.title: 10,000 SALES IN 4 DAYS!
notes.content:
Hello Gnomies,

It's been an absolutely crazy couple of days for Gnomes! As I write this post,[b] over 11,000 people [/b]decided to become one of the Gnomies. Welcome everyone, and thank you all for your trusting a couple of scrappy, unknown indie devs with your hard earned time and money. Your support has given us the opportunity of a lifetime we can't wait to deliver on all of our promised for Gnomes and make more exciting games in the future!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45134742/c0ff82d5d828efd2c8e096534295a758accb0ff8.png[/img]

We've also already had almost[b] 200 positive reviews[/b] are on track for the fabled [b]Overwhelmingly Positive[/b] score. Thank you everyone who's left a review already, it's really motivated us to keep working hard and improve the game, as well as helped us realise what people really care about when looking for their next game. [i]If you haven't already, please leave us a review and let us know what you think, it really helps us out a lot![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45134742/bc550036324d09fcc802627f7b3cc3859f41907b.png[/img]

It's not [i]all [/i]pumpkins and sunflowers over here. [b]We have received ONE negative review[/b] and are working around the clock to address this issue. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45134742/752a21d87ea9f2a29fcf7bd81b7e97e5ee545cf5.png[/img]

In all seriousness. We are working very hard to address some of the technical problems that we didn't anticipate at launch. [b]If you are affected by any of the start up crashes or compatibility issues, please feel free to seek a refund and pick up the game at a later date[/b]. notes.title: Pre-Release FAQs
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

As some of you may know, Gnomes is made by a small team of two developers, we set out to make a tower defense passion project. Since releasing the demo, Gnomes has exploded in popularity which has been quite overwhelming for us. We never could have anticipated the support we've received for your community and fans. You have our most sincere thanks, this experience has been truly life-changing.

It is our intention to launch a feature complete version game that offers our entire vision of the gameplay experience we wanted to create. We wanted to get the game in the hands of our players as soon as possible, so there are some non-essential features that we will be taking care of post-launch.

Here we will provide are the official answers to some of your frequently asked questions and will continue to make updates here and through official announcements. to keep you informed as things change. 

[h3] Will the Gnomes be available in languages other than English? [/h3]
- Not initially, in order to prevent delaying our launch any further we will only be supporting English on launch day. However, we are going to work closely with our community to facilitate language support once we have finished all of the essential "must haves" of the game.

[h3] Is there plans for future Gnomes content? [/h3]
- As it stands we have fulfilled our original scope and vision for Gnomes. However, if there is demand from our players and our resources permit, we may add additional content in the future.

[h3]  Will the Gnomes include Steam Deck and Controller Support? [/h3]
- Only mouse and keyboard will be officially supported at launch. However, the game works very well on Steam deck, and there are already some great community controller layouts. In the future we will add controller support and an officially supported Steam Deck version. However, we want to take the time to do this properly, rather than rushing in a sub par version of either.

[h3] Will mod support/Steam Workshop be available? [/h3]
- Not at launch, however we will investigate the technical feasibility of different levels of mod support post-launch pending player demand.

[h3] Will Gnomes have Linux and MacOS support? [/h3]
- Gnomes currently works perfectly on Linux with Proton.
- Unfortunately, the MacOS security certification process is impossible for us at this time.

[h3] What game engine was used to create Gnomes and why? [/h3]
- We have created a custom game engine using Rust, OpenGL and FMOD. Our custom engine is purpose build for Gnomes which has allowed us to drastically cut development time and resources. However there has been some short comings which still need to be addressed (controller support, localization, etc).

 We will update the FAQs as more questions appear. In the meantime, feel free to join the Discord community if you have any further questions and suggestions: https://discord.gg/Bw9m5Nuna2


This post will be archived and will be maintained here: 

https://steamcommunity.com/app/3133060/discussions/0/595145168817005283/
